review.tagline: Hands-on curriculum for building AI systems from math to agents
review.summary: A course of 528 lessons across 20 phases, covering math foundations, ML fundamentals, LLM engineering, agents, tools and protocols, and production infrastructure. Lessons are runnable code in Python, TypeScript, Rust and Julia, with three graded projects: retrieval evaluation, agent trace debugging and a tool-call firewall. It can be followed on the website, from a local clone, or through tutor skills installed into a coding agent.
review.audience: Developers learning to build LLM, RAG and agent systems from first principles
strengths: Lessons ship runnable code; the first ones need only python3 and no extra dependencies
Three staged projects with local graders (project_test.py --strict) and reference solutions
Tutor skills install via npx skills and save progress to LEARNING.md
Code in Python, TypeScript, Rust and Julia; README translated into 30+ languages
weaknesses: 528 lessons is a large scope; total study time is not stated in the visible README
Project starters fail by design until you implement the stages
Tutor skills need Node.js, npx and a skill-capable coding agent host
GPU and RAM needs for later phases are not stated in the visible README
needs: Needs Python 3.10+, Node.js 22.18+ (TypeScript project), Rust (Tool Call Firewall project), npx (optional, tutor skills)
